verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official CLI (docs.slack.dev/tools/slack-cli) for creating and managing Slack apps, with commands like `slack create` for Bolt project scaffolding, confirmed via docs and a live probe. It's aimed at app/agent development (relevant to AI-native workflows building bots/agents), though it's a general app-dev CLI rather than specifically 'AI-native' branded. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's usability, and no evidence of AI-specific CLI features beyond general app scaffolding.
